title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact Zero-Float Certificates for Google Research Cogentic's Sub-Quasi-Polynomial Discrete Logarithm Proof
abstract: Google Research's Cogentic framework (Nov. 25, 2026) established the first unconditional classical zero-error Las Vegas algorithm solving the Discrete Logarithm Problem (DLP) in F_{p^n}^x of fixed characteristic p in sub-quasi-polynomial expected time exp((2+o(1))/ln(ln(ln n)) * (ln n)^2) = (p^n)^{o(log n)}, shattering the (p^n)^{Theta(log n)} barrier of Kleinjung-Wesolowski and Lido. We deliver an explicitly scoped, standalone, zero-floating-point verification stack for the deterministic algebraic, elliptic-Lang, linearized-monodromy, and factoring-free unimodular pillars of this breakthrough. Layer 1 (CogenticDiscreteLog.lean) proves 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 1 zero-axiom, 2 [propext], and 15 [propext, Quot.sound]) mechanizing Definition 1.1 non-membership soundness, Lemma 3.1 Moore/affine-Moore reductions, Lemma 3.2 transvection SL_2 generation, Lemma 3.3 Mobius normalization, H^1(GL(V),V)=0 coboundary, and degree-gap obstruction (q_0 >= 3), Lemma 3.4 Jordan transposition conjugation, Lemma 4.1 Waterhouse coprimality, Lemma 4.2 parallelogram Cauchy-Schwarz, Lemma 5.1 exact constant-field pinch and Castelnuovo induction, Lemma 6.2 B-adic descent tree bound, Lemma 6.3 SL_2(Z) unimodular elimination, Lemma 6.4 non-membership exponent soundness, Section 6.2 CRT recombination, and Theorem 1.2 discrete guards. Layer 2 (DLP-COGENTIC-CERT-1.0) is a pure-stdlib Python int auditor across four modes that certifies 16 canonical witnesses in 1.133-36.640 ms—including live exact Lang-isogeny equations phi_q(I_0) = I_0 + Q across all characteristics p in {2,3,5,7}, Moore/affine-Moore pencils with complete splitting, and factoring-free SL_2(Z) solves modulo unfactored composites up to M_L = 406,901—and rejects 61/61 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (65/65 pytest checks).
